# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Age:** 18 at death  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v3 c1 P16](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0016), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Ruby is a very handsome girl with a brilliant complexion, large blue eyes, and long, thick, golden hair worn in braids. She has a plump, showy figure, but grows very pale, thin, and hectically flushed during her illness. At her death, her face is noted for its delicate, consecrated, and angelic beauty.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000), [v3 c11 P1](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0001), [v3 c14 P5](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0005), [v3 c14 P31](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0031)_

## Personality

Ruby is gay, cheerful, and good-tempered, though shallow, vain, and highly sentimental. She is preoccupied with romance, suitors, and clothes, enjoying the admiration of boys above all else. She is inclined to be hysterical when frightened or upset. Beneath her frivolous exterior, she harbors a deep terror of death and a poignant longing for life and love.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v3 c11 P3](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0003), [v3 c14 P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 c14 P17](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0017)_

## History

Ruby attends Avonlea School alongside Anne Shirley and Diana Barry, participating in the Story Club and various school plays and concerts. She later attends Queen's Academy with her classmates and earns her teaching license. After graduating, she teaches at Carmody for a year. During the winter she contracts congestion, which develops into galloping consumption. Despite her failing health, she maintains a facade of gaiety and plans to teach at White Sands. During her final summer, she confesses her deep fear of dying and her unfulfilled longing for a simple life and marriage to Anne Shirley. She reconciles with old friends and passes away peacefully in her sleep shortly afterward. She is buried in the Avonlea churchyard.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v2 c26 P58](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0058), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000), [v3 c14 P2](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0002), [v3 c14 P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 c14 P17](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0017), [v3 c14 P23](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0023), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)_

## Quotes

> I’m not afraid but that I’ll go to heaven, Anne. I’m a church member. But—it’ll be all so different. I think—and think—and I get so frightened—and—and—homesick.  <sub>[v3 c14 P13](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0013)</sub>

> I want to live. I want to live like other girls. I—I want to be married, Anne—and—and—have little children.  <sub>[v3 c14 P17](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0017)</sub>

> Isn't it strange how people misunderstand each other, Anne?  <sub>[v3 c14 P23](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0023)</sub>
